description.en: AI image & video production pipeline for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image, image edit with masks, async video generation (including importing local images via auto-upload), pixel-art purification with a measurable 'true pixel' verdict, spec-as-code asset validation/auto-fix, self-check + install + register, batching with fingerprint dedup, and a spend gate that keeps free and paid tiers accounted separately. 27 agent tools + 4 sidebar pages, zero dependencies.
description.zh: AI 生图/生视频全流水线（DeepSeek Harness）：文生图、图生图/局部重绘、异步视频（可导入本地图片，自动换公网 URL）、像素画净化与「真像素」可判定验收、素材规格即代码（校验+自动修复）、自检/装机/登记、批量去重、花钱闸门（免费档独立记账）。27 个工具 + 侧栏 4 页，零依赖。
